title: Targus Wireless Shutter Release Infrared Remote For Canon DSLR Cameras - NEW
categoryName: Cameras & Photo:Camera, Drone & Photo Accessories:Remotes & Shutter Releases
descriptionText: This Targus Wireless Shutter Release Infrared Remote is a must-have for any photographer looking to control their camera wirelessly. It is compatible with Canon and Sony cameras and allows for easy shutter release from a distance. The remote is designed for use with cameras and comes with features such as shutter release, making it an ideal accessory for any photography enthusiast.
